close_reason: Created tests/principal_get_changes_tests.rs (3 tests: get round-trip, specific ids wire, changes sinceState); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create tests/principal_get_changes.rs with 3 async wiremock integration tests. Oracle: RFC 9670 §4.1 Figure 3 for Principal/get response; RFC 8620 §5.1 and §5.2 for request/response shapes.

**Tests:**
1. principal_get_round_trip: mock returns principal_get_response.json fixture; assert resp.list[0].id == "P2342fnddd20", name == "Joe Bloggs", email == Some("joe.bloggs@example.com"); assert outbound request body has methodCalls[0][0] == "Principal/get" and ids == ["P2342fnddd20"] and using contains "urn:ietf:params:jmap:principals".
2. principal_changes_round_trip: mock returns ChangesResponse with oldState "s10", newState "s11", created ["P9"]; assert fields; assert request has sinceState == "s10" and no maxChanges key.
3. principal_changes_with_max_changes: assert request body has maxChanges == 50 when Some(50) passed.

**Algorithm:** Use MockServer::start().await, mount Mock with POST /api/ matcher, call method, capture received_requests, deserialize body, assert fields.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- All 3 tests pass with #[tokio::test].
- Mock verified called exactly once per test.
- No test derives expected values from code under test.
title: Wiremock tests: Principal/get and Principal/changes
